main_text.p: gua quædam, ac tanto faftigio indigna, Ne fit vinolentus, neque percuffor, &c. Atqui Christus etiam jubet, ut crucem tollamus, Luc.9.Et,Paftor,inquit,bonus,anima fuam ponit pro ovibus fuis,Ioan.10. Debebat igitur Paulus ab Episcopo potius, ut angeli-cam viveret vitam, exigere, quæ affectibus careret, quantum ad dignitatis summitatem attinet. Audi igitur, Quoniam paucos exa-ctæ hujusmodi vitæ liceat invenire: Episcopis autem multis in quavis urbe opus erat, qui aliis præeffent, propterea moderatam ab eis virtutem postulavit, quæ in multis inveniri potuit. At nunc, proh dolor, quo excidimus Episcopi, ut adeo ne umbram quidem adeo moderatę virtutis in nobis deprehendi liceat? O parce nobis Domine. Hæc ille.

Quid verò nos hodie dicemus Domino Deo nostro, cujus gloria & Evangelium propter nos male audit, & propter quorum flagitiosam & scandalis plenam vitam pluri-morum salus impeditur, quæ per nos pro-moveri debebat? O Christe Iesu, pastorum princeps, ac magne ovium pastor, miserere tum nostri, tum gregis tui, preciofo sanguine tuo redempti: pafce & custodi tu nos & gregem tuum, qui in nobis est, & emunda nos ab omni peccato, & da nobis omnibus & singulis spiritum tuum sanctum, qui nos ducat in omnem veritatem, regat in omnibus actionibus, sermonibus, cogitationi-

page.notes: Printed "gua" at the start of the page is a fragment of the previous page's paragraph and is kept as printed; it probably stands for "qua". Printed "preciofo" and "pafce" are kept as printed. "Quoniam" has its "Qu" underlined in the original, not marked here. The text has no notes in the margins. The running head is "CONCIONES" with no number. The catchword "bus:" is the end of the word "cogitationi-bus" and is set at the foot right.
